text:
maria_g: Hey support, customer says promo code UPGRADE50 was accepted during checkout earlier but now shows as invalid/expired after they completed a plan upgrade. They lost the free credits. Account: acct_53X9. Can we check?

sam_support: Thanks — can you paste the checkout timestamp and any screenshots or the error you see? Also whether they used the code before today.

maria_g: Checkout was ~2026-03-15 16:12 UTC. Customer insists they never used the code before. Screenshot attached (link): https://redwood.screenshots/xyz123 but important part is API response from our billing service: 
```json
{
  "status": "failed",
  "error": "promo_code_invalid",
  "message": "code expired or not applicable"
}
```

sam_support: Got it. I pulled the promo object (internal): code=UPGRADE50, valid_until=2026-04-01, single_use=true, used_count=1. That used_count is surprising. Do we have any trace of who redeemed it?

logan_billing: Looking at payment events for acct_53X9: there is a successful charge for plan upgrade at 2026-03-15T16:12:07Z. There is also a promo_redemption event at 2026-03-15T16:12:06Z referencing promo_id pr_8a7c. The metadata shows user_id acct_53X9. That suggests redemption happened during the same checkout flow.

sam_support: Huh. Customer says they didn't apply it. Could this be a UI bug auto-applying a stored code? Maria, did they have any saved promo in the account metadata?

maria_g: I checked account metadata via UI and no saved_promo field. Only thing odd: they started a free trial earlier and upgraded mid-flow.

sam_support: Escalating to eng to make sure redemption and upgrade race is handled. @nina_eng can you take a look?

nina_eng: On it. Can you provide the request_id from the checkout? I want the server logs for 16:12:05-16:12:10 UTC.

maria_g: Request id from user screenshot: req_20260315_9f2b. Logs copied here.

nina_eng: Thanks — reproducing locally. Quick summary: when an account is upgraded during checkout we have two parallel flows: promo validation and account state transition. In a small window the promo validation service checks the user's pre-upgrade eligibility state but then a later validation considers the new plan and incorrectly marks the promo as ineligible/expired because of a mis-evaluated rule for plan tiers. Essentially a race where used_count is incremented by an earlier thread but then a second validation sees no entitlement and returns expired.

nina_eng: Repro steps I used: 
1) Start checkout with promo UPGRADE50
2) Trigger plan change + payment concurrently (simulate network delay)
3) Observe promo_redemption success then a follow-up validation that flips status to expired and increments used_count incorrectly.

nina_eng: Minimal fix possibility: ensure promo redemption is idempotent and gated behind a single canonical validation step (don't re-validate against transient post-upgrade state). I'm going to push a small patch to the validation ordering and add an invariant that used_count only increments once.

sam_support: ETA for patch? Customer is impacted and wants credits back now.

nina_eng: I'll cut a canary patch in ~30m and monitor. After deploy we can run a backfill script to revert wrong used_count for affected promos and re-credit accounts impacted.

logan_billing: We can do a manual grant in the meantime. Maria, if you confirm the acct id and how many credits the promo should have granted (UPGRADE50 = $50 credits) I'll create manual credit tx.

maria_g: Confirm acct_53X9 and $50 credits please. Customer already emailed and is getting anxious.

logan_billing: Manual credit created: credit_tx ct_77b2 for acct_53X9, $50, reason: promo misapplied. Please confirm customer sees balance.

maria_g: I told customer to refresh console and they see +$50 now. They confirmed. :relieved:

nina_eng: Deploying canary now. 
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for branch fix/promo-race at 2026-03-16T17:05:00Z — instances: r-infer-3a, r-infer-3b. Monitor windows open.

nina_eng: Canary looks healthy after 12m smoke. I'm merging the change to main and scheduling a small migration to roll back incorrect used_count for any promo where used_count > actual_redemptions. I'll post the migration id when it's done.

nina_eng: Migration queued: mg_20260316_fixpromo_01. Running now. Will notify when finished.

logan_billing: Migration completed and we ran the backfill for promo pr_8a7c — used_count decreased to correct value and affected accounts were re-credited where necessary. I also verified ct_77b2 manual credit exists for acct_53X9.

maria_g: Customer confirmed everything looks normal and they received the $50. Thanks all.

sam_support: Great work. Closing the incident after 24h monitoring. Nina, please open a follow-up to add an alert if promo used_count spikes unexpectedly.

nina_eng: Will do. Thanks for the quick triage everyone. :thumbsup:

maria_g: Thanks everyone!
